Summary: Verify total km for a full in-zone route
Precondition: DRV-A has 20 pings along R1, all inside Z1, every 10 s, no faults
Step to reproduce: Run pipeline; read DRV-A total for the local day
Expected Result: Total km equals sum of segment lengths within tolerance

Summary: Verify each driver's total is kept separate
Precondition: DRV-A and DRV-B both drive R1 inside Z1 on the same local day at different times
Expected Result: Each total equals its own segments; no cross-contamination

Summary: Verify a segment fully inside the zone is counted in full
Precondition: Two consecutive DRV-A pings inside Z1, both at least 10 m from every edge
Step to reproduce: Run pipeline; read length for that segment

Summary: Verify a ping 20 m off road is kept
Precondition: DRV-A ping 20 m off; R1 mid-route, speed valid
Expected Result: Ping kept and included in distance

Summary: Check the conflict log lists each conflicting group once
Expected Result: Two log entries, one per group

Summary: Verify 16:30Z (00:30 local next day) is counted in the next day
Expected Result: Counted in the next local day

Summary: Verify stored timestamps keep the Z suffix after a load and save
Expected Result: Timestamps unchanged and still end in Z

Summary: Verify a late ping is placed by its own timestamp
Precondition: Ping stamped 09:00:30 arrives after the 09:01:00 ping

Summary: Verify daily totals sum to overall total for each driver
Step to reproduce: Compare daily totals to overall totals per driver
Expected Result: Daily totals sum to overall total per driver

Summary: Verify generated intervals are exactly 10 s
Step to reproduce: Measure time between consecutive pings per driver
Expected Result: Every interval exactly 10 s; no gaps or extra pings

Summary: Verify injected gap appears in the violation list
Precondition: 30 s gap recorded in ground truth
Expected Result: Gap appears in violation list, matching ground truth

Summary: Verify no duplicate timestamps per driver in clean generated data
Check the per-driver interval summary is reported
Precondition: Dataset with one gap and one short interval

Summary: Verify warnings do not change distance
Precondition: Same route with and without irregular intervals
